digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 20 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, Rust, TypeScript）和 13 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: anthropics/claude-code
repos.description: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, ex
repos.summary_zh: 终端里的智能编码代理，读懂代码库并自动执行日常任务、解释复杂逻辑与处理 Git 流程

repos.name: paperclipai/paperclip
repos.description: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
repos.summary_zh: 开源团队级 AI Agent 管理平台，让工作中多个智能体统一调度协作不再失控

repos.name: stablyai/orca
repos.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote
repos.summary_zh: 让多个编码 Agent 并行工作的 ADE，支持自带订阅运行任意 Agent，覆盖桌面、移动与远程运行时

repos.name: HKUDS/CLI-Anything
repos.description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
repos.summary_zh: 让所有软件原生支持 AI Agent 的 CLI 枢纽，把任意命令行工具变成 Agent 可直接调用的能力

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine
repos.summary_zh: 免费开源的分布式RESTful搜索引擎，用Java打造，轻松实现海量数据全文检索与实时分析

repos.name: hydra-db/hydradb
repos.description: HydraDB - fast graph database on object storage
repos.summary_zh: 基于对象存储的极速图数据库，用 Rust 打造，让海量图数据低成本存于 S3 也能高速查询

repos.name: huggingface/tokenizers
repos.description: 💥 Fast State-of-the-Art Tokenizers optimized for Research and Production
repos.summary_zh: Hugging Face 出品的高性能分词器库，Rust 编写，兼顾研究实验与生产部署，速度业界领先

repos.name: Nehanth/pooled
repos.description: Peer-to-peer LLM inference in the browser: pool your devices to run big open models, for chat and coding agents.
repos.summary_zh: 浏览器里点对点跑大模型，把多台设备组池分摊推理，聊天写代码都能用

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的开源可组合支付平台，一套接口连通多家支付、分账、风控与令牌化服务商，兼顾 SaaS 与自托管

repos.name: Thinking-Space/One-Shot-OPD
repos.description: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models II: One Training Example
repos.summary_zh: 仅需一个训练样本即可完成大模型在线策略蒸馏，大幅降低蒸馏数据成本

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: trycua/cua
repos.description: Scale computer-use 2.0 with open-source drivers, cross-OS fleets, and benchmarks for training, evaluation, and data generation.
repos.summary_zh: 开源计算机使用驱动与跨系统集群及基准测试，让 AI 代理训练评估和数据生成规模化

repos.name: FareedKhan-dev/train-llm-from-scratch
repos.description: A straightforward method for training your LLM, from downloading data to generating text.
repos.summary_zh: 从零手把手教你训练大模型，覆盖下载数据到生成文本全流程，适合入门实战

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev
repos.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Tauri 的现代化跨平台代理客户端，为 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 提供定制化网络代理体验

repos.name: rust-lang/rust
repos.description: Empowering everyone to build reliable and efficient software.
repos.summary_zh: 内存安全且零成本抽象的现代系统编程语言，让开发者兼顾高性能与可靠性

repos.name: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
repos.description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
repos.summary_zh: 从零手写AI工程全栈的Python实战教程，覆盖训练到部署全链路，适合想真正搞懂底层而非调包的开发者

repos.name: Crosstalk-Solutions/project-nomad
repos.description: Project NOMAD is an offline-first knowledge and education server. Wikipedia, thousands of books, courses, maps, and optional local AI, all running on
repos.summary_zh: 离线优先的知识教育服务器，把维基百科、书籍课程地图和本地AI装进自有硬件，断网也能用

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: vercel/next.js
repos.summary_zh: React 全栈框架，用文件路由和混合渲染让前端开发兼顾开发体验与生产性能

repos.name: pytorch/pytorch
repos.description: Tensors and Dynamic neural networks in Python with strong GPU acceleration
repos.summary_zh: 深度学习框架标杆，用张量计算与动态神经网络配合强力 GPU 加速，让模型训练和推理更高效灵活

repos.name: debpalash/VoiceStudio
repos.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook
repos.summary_zh: 完全本地运行的开源 ElevenLabs 替代品，支持声音克隆、设计与视频配音，覆盖 646 种语言

repos.name: anthropics/financial-services
repos.summary_zh: Anthropic 官方金融数据 MCP 服务器，让 Claude 直连实时行情与财务数据做投研分析

papers.title: Learning to Stop without Learning to Stop: Self-Supervised Confidence Training Improves Reasoning Efficiency
papers.abstract: Reasoning models often generate very long reasoning traces, making inference computationally expensive. Existing approaches typically improve efficiency either through inference-time early-stopping me
papers.summary_zh: 提出自监督置信度训练实现无需显式停止学习的推理提前终止，在保持准确率的同时显著缩短推理链长度

papers.title: User Model Extraction via Belief Self-Distillation
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) implicitly infer attributes of their users and adapt their behavior accordingly, yet these beliefs remain difficult to inspect and causally manipulate. We introduce Belief
papers.summary_zh: 提出信念自蒸馏框架，统一线性与因果探针，实现大模型用户信念的读取与因果操控

papers.title: Strategically Diverse Sampling for Self-Training

papers.summary_zh: 提出策略性多样化采样方法用于自训练，通过鼓励生成语义差异更大的响应提升数据质量与训练效果

papers.title: Compact Documentation for Coding Agents: A Benchmark, an Optimizer, and Why It Does Not Transfer
papers.abstract: We investigate whether natural-language documentation helps coding agents resolve software issues, and we build the tools to construct and evaluate it. We introduce a roundtrip benchmark that scores c

papers.abstract: We study false-alert control when screening for text generated by artificial intelligence (AI). The screening procedure selects document prefixes and detectors from observed evidence and may stop befo
papers.summary_zh: 提出两种有限样本共形构造实现文档内AI文本自适应筛查，在动态前缀与检测器选择下有效控制误报率

papers.title: Multi-agent Scaling Across Disjunctive and Compensatory Tasks
papers.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems are often expected to improve as team size increases, yet the scaling behavior may depend on task structure. Our central contribution is to introduce Steiner's taxonomy of grou
papers.summary_zh: 引入Steiner群体任务分类框架分析多智能体LLM扩展，揭示团队规模增大在析取与补偿任务中的差异化表现

papers.title: First-Order Stationarity of Reverse Diffusions
papers.abstract: Recent literature has shown a strong connection between optimization and sampling. We develop the corresponding first-order theory for diffusion models. First, the SDE-based reverse-time flows of over
papers.summary_zh: 建立扩散模型反向SDE的一阶平稳性理论，证明过阻尼与欠阻尼Langevin反向流以显式指数收缩相对Fisher散度

papers.title: Statistical attribute alignment for black-box generative AI via output post-processing
papers.abstract: Generative AI systems are increasingly used, but aligning their outputs with user requirements poses a continuing challenge. Here, we aim to ensure that the distribution of an attribute of an AI-gener
papers.summary_zh: 提出黑盒生成AI输出后处理的统计属性对齐方法，无需访问模型内部即可使输出属性分布匹配用户指定目标

papers.title: OC-GS: Gaussian Splatting for Irregular Turntable Capture
papers.abstract: Uneven rotation and dropped frames make equal-angle assumptions unreliable for turntable reconstruction. We present OC-GS, an object-centric Gaussian splatting that refines each image's angle while ma
papers.summary_zh: 提出轨道一致的对象中心高斯泼溅方法，通过联合优化每张图像角度与共享相机旋转轴枢轴，解决转台不规则旋转和丢帧问题

papers.title: Common-Mode Collapse and Recovery in Direct Feedback Alignment
papers.abstract: Direct feedback alignment (DFA) trains hidden layers through fixed random projections of output error. With tanh hidden units and independent sigmoid outputs, plain stochastic gradient descent can sta

papers.title: Gap-free Differentially Private PCA for Gaussian Data
papers.abstract: We give a gap-free differentially private algorithm for the principal component analysis (PCA) problem with Gaussian data.
papers.summary_zh: 提出面向高斯数据的无间隙差分隐私PCA算法，消除隐私与精度间的权衡间隙

papers.title: New LoRA Skills Should Read but Never Write
papers.abstract: Low-rank adapters (LoRA) make it cheap to fine-tune a large language model once per task, but combining several independently trained adapters into one model remains difficult: merging the updates in
papers.summary_zh: 提出只读不写的LoRA组合新范式，避免权重合并干扰，无需重训即可高效整合多任务适配器

papers.title: Trust Guided Decision Transformer
